cause: Both source mutation staging and managed artifact registration attempted sync_all on a cloned capability-directory descriptor. Linux O_PATH handles cannot be fsynced, so the calls failed with EBADF before durable write completion.
change: Use one shared helper to open a readable descriptor for the held directory through the relative dot path, then sync it. Do not resolve the original pathname again and do not ignore the synchronization error. Existing non-Unix file-sync behavior is unchanged.

local_validation.boundary: uncommitted root-cause patch with the exact file hashes below
local_validation.command: rtk proxy cargo test -p awr-runtime --lib --test artifacts --test security_artifact_bounds --locked

limitations: The Linux baseline is a real failed native run and is retained. Local macOS regression does not prove the Linux fix; all three platforms need a new source-bound run.
Process-kill tests do not prove power-loss durability. Windows directory fsync is not newly claimed.
